_: The fourteen magic tablets the lecterns make, and which lectern makes which.
WHAT IS DATA AND WHAT IS NOT. A tablet's LEVEL, RUNES and EXPERIENCE are not here: they
are read out of magic_spell_table, the same row the spell itself is cast from, so a tablet
can never cost something different from the spell it stores. What IS here is the part the
spell row has no opinion about - the obj, its art, and which lecterns list it.
THE LECTERN TABLE IS OSRS'S. Seven lecterns, and the models say which is which: 1 is plain,
2 4 and 6 carry a bird's head, 3 5 and 7 a horned one, and 6 and 7 are gilded. That is the
oak / eagle / demon / teak eagle / teak demon / mahogany eagle / mahogany demon ladder, and
each one's tablet list below is the wiki's, minus the four tablets whose spells do not exist
at 377 (Kourend, Civitas illa Fortis, the two boat ones) and the onyx enchant.
The biggest list is eight, which is exactly the number of rows the window has. That is not a
coincidence worth relying on - poh_tab_pick pages like the other two windows - but it does
mean no lectern needs a second page today.
THE ART IS OSRS'S OWN (Corey, 2026-09-11). The fourteen tablets were the real items all along:
OSRS objs 8007-8020, imported with tools/models/importosrs.py from the rev 240 cache, models
re-encoded by osrs2ob2.py and round-trip verified. They replace the recoloured Zaros stone slab
the first version used, and they carry their OSRS name, description, 1g weight, 2d camera and
- the point of the round - stackable=yes. Each one's model, icon camera and name below are the
cache's, not a decision made here.
WINDOW LABELS. The window's name column is 126px in p12_full and two OSRS names do not fit:
'Enchant sapphire or opal' is 140px and 'Enchant emerald or jade' 138px. Those two get a
'label', the same trim the furniture window's rows use; the obj keeps the full OSRS name.

_: Teleport to house has no button in the 377 spellbook and never will - it was added to the
game in 2006 with Construction, after this revision. The row exists so its tablet's recipe
comes from the same table as every other tablet's; nothing can cast it, because db_find on
magic_spell_table:spell is the only way in and only poh_tablets.rs2 asks for this id.
Breaking a tablet plays OSRS's own tablet-break animation (seq 4069) and its graphic
(spotanim 678, which animates itself on OSRS seq 4072), imported by
tools/models/importosrsspot.py. Before this round every break played the spell's cast -
human_castteleport and teleport_casting for a teleport - which is the animation for casting
the spell, not for smashing a tablet. Candidate seqs 4069, 4070, 4071 and 4731 were rendered
on a player (tools/models/../render/osrsanim.py) and looked at: 4069 raises the tablet and
brings it down, 4071 and 4731 are the teleport shrink, 4070 is a plank carry.
Make 1 / 5 / 10 / X, as buttons in the window (Corey, 2026-09-11). The chosen quantity is
kept in %poh_tab_qty (temp) so it survives a page of the window and the rest of the visit,
and X asks with p_countdialog - the same prompt Cook X uses. The cap is an inventory's
worth: a tablet needs a soft clay and clay does not stack, so 28 is already more than can
be carried.
